mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 70 degrees with overcast skies at Verona Community Park. We expect an overnight low of 60 degrees with no rain predicted, all under a Waning Crescent moon.

The city has released an update regarding the arrest of a school staff member, Halla Nelson, following an investigation into a 2019 incident. Additionally, the city is moving into phase two of the Highway M construction project starting the week of September 7, which will shift traffic patterns to maintain one lane in each direction.

This weekend is packed with entertainment. Today, enjoy live music at both Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, you can drop in for a yoga session at Insight Wellness. Looking ahead, next Tuesday features trivia nights at Hop Haus Brewing Company and the Wisconsin Brewing Company, followed by the Downtown Farmer's Market and more live music at Paddy Mac's on Wednesday.
The Verona Police Department reported that a 34-year-old individual was arrested for sexual assault of a child, stemming from an incident that occurred on Sunday, August 30, 2026.

Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Chocolate Covered Strawberry. The store is currently open, but please note that it is closing in under an hour, so you have just enough time to grab a scoop before they close for the night.
